messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "may be repeated at the same dose"
set: ["may be repeated at the same dose", "splitting the dose may be needed", "dose may be gradually increased", "may be kept at room temperature", "next dose may be delayed based on the results", "taken at approximately the same time each day", "take at around the same time each day", "lower dose may be an option", "Patients may be switched to the extended-release 450 mg dose", "can be taken any time of the day but take at the same time each day", "take with food at the same time each day", "dose needs may be different during pregnancy", "daily dose may be raised in 5 mg increments at weekly intervals", "may be habit-forming", "daily dose may be raised in 2.5 mg increments at weekly intervals", "take prescribed dose every four to six hours at the same time every day"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
